issues.failure_explanation: The formula is stated for SU(2), where L_1 and L_2 range over half-integers. A sum written from L_1=0 in unit steps drops every half-integer intermediate L_1 (for example, when \sum\bl^{(1)} is a half-integer), so it does not specialise eq. (dim_GE_rec) correctly. The same indexing is reused in Corollary cor:added-2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Sum L_1 and L_2 over \calL_G with the integrality constraint L+L_1+L_2\in\Z, starting from the minimal admissible value.
issues.overall_effect: The recursive dimension counts are unreliable for SU(2) with half-integer labels.
issues.title: Recursive SU(2) dimension formula sums only over integer L_1, L_2
issues.why_classification: A local reindexing of the sums restores the formula; no argument changes.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: However, estimating the remainder as in~\eqref{eq:dimpi_asymp} is beyond the scope of this manuscript.

issues.failure_explanation: The cited limit only gives |M_{l,L}|/binom = Gaussian density + o(1). Subtracting the values at L and L+1 therefore yields an o(1) error, not o(N^{-3/2}). Moreover, for fixed l, Var_l ~ N^2, so the leading term (2L+1)/(Var^{3/2}) is of order N^{-3}. Both the deduced o(N^{-3/2}) remainder and the conjectured O(N^{-5/2}) remainder dominate the main term. The asymptotic statement is therefore unsupported and vacuous as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must prove a local limit theorem for consecutive Gaussian-binomial coefficients with an error that is relatively small compared to N^{-3}, and restate the remainder in the correct scale.
issues.overall_effect: The stated GE-PI asymptotic for identical l is not established. The prose and numerical claims of N^{-5/2} error decay for GE-PI estimates lack a consistent theoretical basis.
issues.title: Claimed o(N^{-3/2}) GE-PI asymptotic does not follow from Takács limit and exceeds the leading term
issues.why_classification: The advertised asymptotic regime for the identical-l GE-PI case has no valid support, and fixing it requires a new local limit argument.
